title: RUST_CODE.BBS · The board goes dark
venue: Arthur's site · drawn during Message Boards · never posted
logline: The board's last night: the banner gone, the screen gray, the number where it was drawn as a blank, and the desk empty — the chorus gone into the monitor's dark or under the desk or into the parody. The dog finds one behind the lamp's base. Wood leaves it there. It's still there in 2018.

panels.composition: The screen gray, no banner, a blank where the number was.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a gray computer screen with no banner and a small blank space where a number used to be

panels.composition: The desk, empty in the lamp's circle.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, an empty desk in a lamp's circle of light

panels.composition: BARNABY nosing behind the lamp's base: one stick figure, sitting, faint.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a dog nosing behind a desk lamp's base where one tiny faint stick figure sits

panels.composition: WOOD not moving it. Switching the lamp off. The figure the last thing lit.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man switching off a desk lamp with one tiny stick figure behind its base the last thing lit

art.line: digitized brush-pen on bristol; the stick figures in ballpoint; the screen as a gray rectangle with a banner in it
art.palette: muddy early-digital flats; the screen's phosphor green, once

notes: One stays behind the lamp. Compare dw_2018-08-15 (one climbs out again).
